title: Project scaffolding and build setup
description: Create pyproject.toml with all dependencies, src/video_capture_mcp/ package structure, __init__.py, and verify the project builds with uv.

title: Shared utilities module
description: Create utils.py with make_image_result() helper that builds CallToolResult with ImageContent (base64 PNG).

title: Camera device listing
description: Implement list_cameras() and wire up as list_devices MCP tool.

title: Photo capture tool
description: Implement capture_frame() with warm-up frame discard. Wire up as capture_photo MCP tool.

title: Video capture tool
description: Implement record_video() with codec fallback. Wire up as capture_video MCP tool.

title: C++ error handling and edge-case tests
description: Add tests for native macOS binary: invalid device index, camera busy, timeout, malformed JSON-RPC input, and missing params. Verify all error paths return proper JSON-RPC error responses.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid device_index returns JSON-RPC error with descriptive message
Malformed JSON-RPC input returns parse error (-32700)
Missing required params return invalid params error (-32602)
Tests can run without a camera attached (mock or skip gracefully)

title: Finalize docs for native v3.0 release
description: Final review of README.md for v3.0 release. Ensure build instructions, configuration examples, and cross-platform fallback docs are accurate and complete.
acceptance_criteria: README build instructions produce working binary
Claude Code and Claude Desktop config examples are correct

title: Fix deprecated UTType API for macOS 15+
description: Fix deprecated UTType API usage to support macOS 15 Sequoia. Commit 8f284c6.

title: Add NDJSON transport support
description: Add auto-detection of NDJSON (newline-delimited) transport alongside existing Content-Length (LSP-style) framing. Commit 8ca2ca3.

title: Add BSD 2-Clause license for open source release
description: Add LICENSE file (BSD 2-Clause) and update README license reference from MIT. Commit 35d28e7.
